description: Utility functions and constants for platform detection, environment checks, DOM manipulations, and other helper methods in a web application.

methods.name: getPlatformString
methods.description: Determines the platform string based on navigator.platform and application type (desktop or web).

methods.name: getPlatform
methods.description: Returns the platform enum based on device info or platform string.

methods.name: isSameDay
methods.description: Checks if two dates are on the same calendar day.

methods.name: debounce
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a function to limit its execution rate.

methods.name: preventRefreshing
methods.description: Prevents page refresh during an async operation by setting window.onbeforeunload.

methods.name: destroyAllObjectProperties
methods.description: Deletes all properties of an object.

methods.name: isDesktopApplication
methods.description: Returns true if the application is running on a desktop platform.

methods.name: getDesktopVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the desktop application version from window.electronAppVersion.

methods.name: isEmailValid
methods.description: Validates an email string against EMAIL_REGEX.

methods.name: openInNewTab
methods.description: Opens a URL in a new browser tab.

methods.name: convertStringifiedBooleanToBoolean
methods.description: Converts a string 'true'/'false' to a boolean value.

methods.name: isIOS
methods.description: Detects if the device is running iOS.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Detects if the device is running Android.

methods.name: disableIosTextFieldZoom
methods.description: Prevents iOS zoom on text fields by modifying viewport meta tag.

methods.name: isMobileScreen
methods.description: Checks if the current screen matches mobile media query.

methods.name: isTabletScreen
methods.description: Checks if the current screen matches tablet media query.

methods.name: isTabletOrMobileScreen
methods.description: Checks if the current screen is either mobile or tablet.

methods.name: getBase64FromBlob
methods.description: Converts a Blob object to a base64 string.
